name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: The iconic Swiss cheese plant with large, fenestrated leaves. Thrives in bright indirect light and makes a bold tropical statement in any living space.

name: Matte Black Ceramic Pot
description: Minimalist matte black ceramic pot with a drainage hole and matching saucer. Elevates any plant display with a sleek contemporary aesthetic.

name: Premium Aerated Potting Mix
description: Professional-grade potting mix blended with perlite, coco coir, and worm castings. Promotes healthy root growth and excellent drainage for all indoor plants.

name: Full Spectrum LED Grow Light
description: Compact clip-on full spectrum LED grow light with 3 brightness modes and a 360° flexible gooseneck. Perfect for low-light rooms and seedling propagation.

name: Copper Long-Neck Watering Can
description: Elegant copper-finish watering can with a precision long-neck spout for targeted watering. Holds 1.5L and reduces overwatering on delicate houseplants.

name: Organic Liquid Plant Food
description: OMRI-certified organic liquid fertilizer enriched with seaweed extract, fish emulsion, and mycorrhizal fungi. Promotes lush, vibrant growth with every watering.

name: Bohemian Macramé Plant Hanger
description: Handcrafted cotton macramé plant hanger in a classic bohemian knot pattern. Fits pots up to 6 inches and adds a textural accent to walls and ceilings.

name: Titanium Bypass Pruning Shears
description: Professional-grade titanium-coated bypass pruning shears with a sap groove and ergonomic non-slip grip. Delivers clean cuts to minimise plant stress.
